status: User-approved parametric specification and annotated reference on 2026-10-10. No generator, model or app implementation.
origin: Single module: rear-plane width centre at front-valance bottom height. Assembly: rear-plane centre of total layout width.

object.unitMeaning: One placeable module containing the sloped canopy and front valance; the existing identifier is retained for this asset family.

authority: Source image guides silhouette and default colour family. Numeric profile and modular layout rules define construction; the historical eight-stripe drawing is an assembly example.
productionMethod: Direct parametric YZ-profile extrusion and X repetition, including a narrowed last strip; no Blender intermediary required.

appearance.assignment: solid: all modules use the selected single material/colour. alternating: exactly two palette entries, module i uses palette[i modulo 2]. A partial final module keeps its index. Explicit module overrides apply after the mode assignment.
appearance.validation: Reject unsupported modes. An explicitly supplied palette requires exactly one entry in solid mode or exactly two in alternating mode; reject an explicit empty list in either mode. Omitted palette uses blue in solid mode or blue/ivory in alternating mode. Omitted mode defaults to alternating.

inputModes.count: Positive finite module-equivalent count q, including fractions: W=q*w. q=5.3 creates five full strips and a final 0.3*w strip.
inputModes.width: Positive finite target width W and nominal width w: q=W/w. Both modes use N=ceil(q); first N-1 widths are w and final width W-(N-1)*w. Exact multiples keep a full last strip, not an extra zero-width strip.

assembly.modeExclusivity: Select fractional-count or target-width mode, not both. Reject nonpositive/nonfinite inputs and invalid profile or appearance parameters. With neither mode specified, use q=8.
assembly.centres: x_i=-W/2+sum(widths[0:i])+widths[i]/2; rear-plane Y and valance-bottom Z are shared.
assembly.edgeFinish: Contiguous modules with identical YZ profiles share exact boundary positions. Remove both internal coincident side caps, weld the common profile boundary and preserve logical module/material regions; leave only the two exposed outer ends capped. Standalone modules remain closed.
assembly.partialModule: Generate the same YZ profile with the smaller X extrusion. Do not clip the valance, alter slope/depth/height, leave a gap or stretch the whole run to accommodate the remainder.
assembly.sizeOrder: Resolve L/theta/V and fractional count or width; build profile and layout; calculate bounds; apply an explicit overall XYZ scale once; then appearance mapping. Final nonuniform Y/Z scaling changes effective slope to atan2(scaleZ*sin(theta),scaleY*cos(theta)); vertical valance stays parallel to Z. Omit overall scaling when parameter lengths/angle must be retained exactly.
assembly.scope: Straight planar runs with matching module profiles; no corners, terrain fitting, automatic mounting or animation.
assembly.numericBoundary: Use unrounded dimensions to resolve q. For floating point arithmetic only, snap q to a positive integer k when abs(q-k)<=8*Number.EPSILON*max(1,abs(q)); use W=k*w in that case. Never snap to zero or use the 1 mm model acceptance tolerance for module counting. Preserve real partial strips.
assembly.profileSharing: Resolve one L, theta and V for the run before extrusion; all strips, including the partial strip, share that profile.

reference.note: Default eight-module assembly. FRONT shows the outer fold; BACK shows rear thickness and the inner fold. Former RIGHT is relabelled LEFT without changing the blue side profile. BOTTOM shows the 20 mm valance bottom-face boundary. TOP and THREE-QUARTER are preserved. Parameter, fractional-width and colour notes describe configuration; SINGLE UNIT was replaced by an assembly heading.

front.screenPalette: blue first, ivory last in default eight-module assembly

back.screenPalette: ivory first, blue last in default eight-module assembly
back.occlusion: Outer front fold is hidden, not an extra visible back line.

left.revision: Relabel original RIGHT only; preserve side geometry and colour.

bottom.revision: Add one cross-width line inside the front outline; preserve existing colours, size and placement.
bottom.occlusion: Inner vertical valance face BC projects edge-on to the same boundary. This is a surface junction, not a gap, groove or extra layer.

reference.elevationDimensionPolicy: FRONT and BACK show folded structure without total-height callouts. Remove the original FRONT 0.42 m text, arrows and dimension line. LEFT and numeric geometry define dimensions. Overall height remains H=V+L*sin(theta), not L+V; the assembly heading may retain default bounds.

moduleWidth.meaning: Nominal X width of one complete strip.

canopyLength.meaning: L: true length along the upper sloping surface, from rear upper edge to front fold.

canopyAngleDegrees.meaning: theta: downward slope from horizontal toward the front; convert to radians for trigonometry.

valanceLength.meaning: V: vertical distance from front outer fold to bottom edge. Always parallel to local Z; never rotates with canopy angle.

profileThickness.meaning: Fixed construction thicknesses t and d before explicit whole-unit scaling; canopy thickness is vertical, not normal.

profileGeneration.canopyPlanes: Upper Z=H+m*Y; lower Z=H-t+m*Y. Lower plane meets valance rear at Y=-P+d.
profileGeneration.validation: All scalar inputs finite. w,L,V>0; 0<=theta<90 degrees; P>d and V-t+d*tan(theta)>0. Reject invalid or degenerate geometry; do not clamp silently.
profileGeneration.valanceRule: Outer face Y=-P, Z=0..V. Inner face Y=-P+d meets the lower canopy plane; use the shared polygon to join without a gap, overlap or extra wedge.
profileGeneration.defaultsAuthority: object.size and yzPolygon are the evaluated defaults only. Recalculate from parameters for every configuration, never reuse fixed default vertices after an input changes.
